headline: Revenue growth hits a decade high as margins broaden
summary_short: Medtronic reported quarterly revenue of $9.81B (company-stated +9.9% y/y as reported, +6.6% organic — its strongest growth in a decade) with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.96 (+17.1% y/y per the release) and net income of $1.24B (+17.6% y/y per the release); non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.55, ahead of guidance.
summary_long: Revenue of $9.81B grew 9.9% as reported / 6.6% organic (company-stated), led by Cardiovascular's $3.80B (+13.8%, Cardiac Ablation Solutions +78% globally, continued Cardiac Rhythm Management strength) and Diabetes' $837M (+15.0%). GAAP operating profit was $1.87B (+30.4%) on revenue leverage, though non-GAAP operating margin fell 230bp to 25.5%, held back 160bp by the MiniMed Blackstone payment and 80bp by tariffs. Net income was $1.24B (+17.6%) and diluted EPS $0.96 (+17.1%); non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.55, ahead of guidance. Free cash flow for the fiscal year was $5.43B. The board raised the quarterly dividend to $0.72/share for next quarter and issued initial next-fiscal-year guidance of 6.75-7.25% organic revenue growth and $5.90-$6.00 non-GAAP diluted EPS.

drivers.explanation: Company-disclosed +9.9% reported / +6.6% organic, led by Cardiovascular (+13.8%, Cardiac Ablation Solutions +78% globally, CRM strength) and Diabetes (+15.0%).
GAAP operating profit +30.4% on revenue growth and leverage; non-GAAP operating margin fell 230bp, with 160bp attributed to the MiniMed Blackstone payment and 80bp to tariffs.
Growth tracks operating profit gains; the release does not separately explain net income or EPS movement beyond the operating-profit and tax lines.

Management framed the quarter as capping the company's strongest annual revenue growth in a decade, citing disciplined execution, strength in CRM/CST/Surgical, and building momentum in Affera, Symplicity, Hugo, Altaviva and Stealth AXiS.
